items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Buck Clayton was with that group, Gene Sedric, Kansas Fields and Red Phillips.

ctx.x: Patterson. they called him Pork Chop Pork Chop and I would go to the St. Germain Brazzierie and we'd have big meals. We had a lot of fun.

You recorded some pieces with Mezz Mezzrow, it was a sextet, a concert at the Theater Champs Elysee. Let's say, Buck Clayton was with that group, Gene Sedric, Kansas Fields and Red Phillips. It was really, I guess -- if it was March 1st, 1953, it was for the Vogue Record Company. I guess it was around the same time as the "Saints" was recorded that came out on your album.
Well, that same group we did a thing in Strasburg, France, and that's where the "Saints" was recorded on the tape. That's what I got on my album.
